bb.name: Activity Sidebar
bb.description: Replaces bb's thread list with one Activity list of every parent thread from every project, latest first, with pinned threads above it and the Working, Asleep and Archived shelves folded at its foot. A filter narrows it to one project. Each row shows the thread's agent, its project's coloured initial, its title, its pull request, how many threads run under it, and its state or how long ago it last moved. Right-click a row for its menu (rename, pin, copy, sleep or wake, archive, delete); under the pointer, its corner offers Archive. A thread put to sleep waits on Asleep until its time, then comes back to the top.
